verdict: Ads have been paused since Sep 15; organic is holding but fading.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta went dark on September 15 and has not run since — all 6 leads this period came from the first 8 days of the window when ads were still active. Without paid support, your Google Business Profile and Instagram have both softened: offline intent actions (calls and direction requests) are down 18% week-over-week, and Instagram reach has effectively flatlined. Ads are being reactivated to arrest that slide before organic intent erodes further. You should expect lead volume and GBP engagement to recover once paid traffic is back in market.
